subject.title: feat: preview spreadsheets and slide decks

question: Should ClickClack accept bounded synchronous browser-side parsing of Office Open XML archives as the permanent preview boundary?
rationale: The patch has no concrete correctness or security defect, but it creates ongoing product and operational ownership of attacker-controlled ZIP/XML parsing on the UI thread, which automation cannot approve on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Accept bounded client parsing
options.body: Merge with the documented hard limits and authenticated fallback, treating the unrelated direct-message timeout through normal CI rerun policy.

options.title: Require worker isolation
options.body: Move archive and XML parsing into a terminable worker before merge for stronger UI-thread containment.

options.title: Keep downloads only
options.body: Decline Office previews and retain authenticated download behavior for spreadsheets and slide decks.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded client parsing
recommendation.body: Merge with the documented hard limits and authenticated fallback, treating the unrelated direct-message timeout through normal CI rerun policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger carried final hardening and documentation work on the merged artifact-viewer foundation and is the strongest available owner for accepting its permanent parser boundary.
